ModMetaData.name: RWoM Integrations
ModMetaData.author: HUGINN (RWoM original author: Torann)
ModMetaData.description:
Optional third-party compatibility for A RimWorld of Magic (Continued).
INTEGRATIONS Each entry names the author or maintainer of the targeted version.
- Vanilla Gravship Expanded - Chapters 1 and 2 (Vanilla Expanded team): oxygen pipes, flight fuel, gravengine power and shield interception. - Vanilla Psycasts Expanded / Vanilla Expanded Framework (Vanilla Expanded team): prevents overlapping RWoM and external casts. - Kure's Class Expansion - 1.7 Unofficial (kelnmaari): repairs Pridestalker class degrees and stamina-potion addiction links. - Humanoid Alien Races (erdelf): respects race and backstory trait restrictions. - Pawnmorpher (The Pawnmorpher Team): preserves RWoM progression components during race changes; this does not port Pawnmorpher itself to 1.7. - Giddy-Up 2 - Continued (Meme Goddess): mounting and dismounting hooks for RWoM abilities. - Simple Sidearms - Reworked (Dreadarm): preserves remembered weapons when RWoM abilities change equipment. - (1.7)Multiplayer-temp (RimWorld Multiplayer Team): ability and command synchronization, including owner-aware casts across maps. - ISEKAI DUNGEONS ADD-ON (Poupun): RWoM dungeon definitions; the external exact-name compatibility check still applies. - RimLogging / Logging Framework (RimWorks): optional structured diagnostics, with Verse.Log fallback. - MedPod (sumghai): excludes Arcane Weakness from treatment. - Hellsing ARMS Ultimate (Baskerville): connects holy and decay damage effects. - Ability AI (SaintWacko): hands RWoM autocast ownership to Ability AI — colonist autocast, NPC casting, movement, summons and area spells are decided there, with rules for 250 spells; right-click a spell button for Ability AI's autocast menu. Without Ability AI the classic RWoM autocast is untouched.
RETAINED LEGACY HOOKS These preserve existing behavior; they are not a claim of full 1.7 support.
- Prison Labor (Avius, Hazzer): retains prisoner-work checks for sentinels. - No Job Authors (Jellypowered): allows shared unfinished work at magic workstations. - Children, school and learning (Dylan): replaces inherited full classes with matching potential on birth.
Targets are optional and are not bundled. Official RimWorld DLC support remains in RWoM Content.
DEVELOPMENT PACKAGE Use matching RWoM Core, Content and Integrations builds. Do not combine with older RWoM releases that still contain these adapters. Final package and save-compatibility acceptance is in progress; this is not yet a public release.
Load after Core, Content and the installed optional targets. Read README.md for migration and rollback instructions.
